prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: roof tiles blown off in a storm. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If storm winds have blown roof tiles from your home, you must take reasonable steps to prevent further damage as soon as it is safe to do so. This may include placing a temporary cover over the exposed area and arranging an urgent repair. You should keep any invoices and photographs for your claim."},{"type":"fact","content":"We will usually treat blown-off roof tiles as storm damage where the weather conditions were sufficiently severe and the loss was sudden and accidental. Wear and tear, lack of maintenance, or existing damage is not covered under this section. The condition of the roof before the event may affect our decision."},{"type":"fact","content":"If roof tiles are missing after a storm, please tell us promptly and do not wait for the next inspection or repair visit. Any improvement beyond the original condition is not insured."},{"type":"fact","content":"Storm damage to roof tiles is assessed against the weather event and the condition of the property.
